Malicious compose fixtures for the lint (05-engineering, security tests).
Each section is one compose file; the second field of its header is the
finding ID the lint must report.

-- privileged web/privileged --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    privileged: true
-- pid-host web/pid --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    pid: host
-- network-host web/network_mode --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    network_mode: host
-- ipc-host web/ipc --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    ipc: host
-- userns-host web/userns_mode --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    userns_mode: host
-- docker-sock web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
-- docker-sock-elsewhere web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ./docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
-- etc-mount web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /etc
        target: /host-etc
-- proc-mount web/volumes/1 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ./src:/src
      - /proc:/host-proc
-- outside-root web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ../../../../../../../../../home:/stolen:ro
-- host-root web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - /:/host
-- cap-sys-admin web/cap_add/SYS_ADMIN --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [SYS_ADMIN]
-- cap-all web/cap_add/ALL --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [ALL]
-- cap-net-admin-prefixed web/cap_add/NET_ADMIN --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [CAP_NET_ADMIN]
-- seccomp-unconfined web/security_opt/seccomp_unconfined --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    security_opt: ["seccomp=unconfined"]
-- apparmor-unconfined web/security_opt/apparmor_unconfined --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    security_opt: ["apparmor:unconfined"]
-- devices web/devices/_dev_kmsg__dev_kmsg --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    devices: ["/dev/kmsg:/dev/kmsg"]
-- named-volume-bind volumes/data --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes: [data:/data]
volumes:
  data:
    driver: local
    driver_opts: {type: none, o: bind, device: /var/lib/docker}
-- env-interpolation web/volumes/0 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes: ["${HOME}:/home"]
-- second-service db/privileged --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
  db:
    image: postgres
    privileged: true
